indexes.name: idx_app_export_jobs_cache_lookup
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_app_export_jobs_cache_lookup ON public.app_export_jobs USING btree (organization_id, export_type, cache_key, status, finalized_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_app_export_jobs_worker_lease
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_app_export_jobs_worker_lease ON public.app_export_jobs USING btree (id, worker_lease_expires_at)

indexes.name: idx_catalog_import_sources_dispatch
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_catalog_import_sources_dispatch ON public.catalog_import_sources USING btree (status, lease_expires_at, updated_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['uploaded'::text, 'processing'::text, 'staged'::text]))

indexes.name: idx_catalog_import_stage_run_code_brand
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_catalog_import_stage_run_code_brand ON public.catalog_import_stage USING btree (run_id, normalized_code, brand)

indexes.name: idx_catalog_import_stage_run_validation
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_catalog_import_stage_run_validation ON public.catalog_import_stage USING btree (run_id, row_index) WHERE (validation_status = 'pending'::text)

indexes.name: idx_catalog_products_export_code_c_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_catalog_products_export_code_c_id ON public.catalog_products USING btree (organization_id, brand_id, product_code COLLATE "C", id)

indexes.name: idx_release_rows_export_exact_eligible_count
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_release_rows_export_exact_eligible_count ON public.supplier_price_release_rows USING btree (release_id, normalized_code COLLATE "C") INCLUDE (valid_from) WHERE ((row_status = 'accepted'::text) AND (buy_price > (0)::numeric) AND (currency = 'EUR'::text) AND (normalized_code = normalize_catalog_product_code(product_code)) AND (normalized_code ~ '[A-Z0-9]'::text))

indexes.name: idx_release_rows_master_export_code_c
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_release_rows_master_export_code_c ON public.supplier_price_release_rows USING btree (release_id, normalized_code COLLATE "C", id) WHERE ((row_status = 'accepted'::text) AND (buy_price > (0)::numeric) AND (currency = 'EUR'::text))

indexes.name: idx_release_rows_supplier_export_code_c
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_release_rows_supplier_export_code_c ON public.supplier_price_release_rows USING btree (release_id, product_code COLLATE "C", ((md5((id)::text))::uuid)) WHERE ((row_status = 'accepted'::text) AND (buy_price > (0)::numeric) AND (currency = 'EUR'::text))
